pick.title: Hospitals’ next lucrative bet — longevity clinics
pick.headline: Hospitals, Having Monetized Illness, Move Upstream to Monetize Not Being Sick
pick.take: Health systems have identified a new service line: the healthy, who until now were an untapped revenue source. The business case is sound, since a well person is just a patient the system hasn't billed yet. Expect a rigorous prospectus and a much thinner evidence base.
